test_date_ranges_lazy_with_literals: test the polars date_ranges function with literal start, end dates and interval in lazy mode
test_date_ranges_lazy_with_expressions: test the polars date_ranges function using column expressions as start and end arguments in lazy mode
test_date_ranges_eager: test the polars date_ranges function with eager=True to generate date ranges from Series inputs
test_date_ranges_broadcasting: test the polars date_ranges function with scalar start or end values broadcasting across a column
test_date_ranges_start_end_interval_forw: test the polars date_ranges function with different closed interval options: both, left, right, none
